build: worktree rebased on main 95a7a6d (Tournament Arena v2, P2-ARN-04)
environment: isolated: web :3500 (next dev), api :4300, realtime :2600, admin :3501, scratch PGlite; Chrome headless new (ANGLE Metal)

gaps.title: Suspending a player does not end their session: API calls keep working, a connected player stays in the world, chats and can be staked into a match
steps: Sign in as qa_lv30 (API token) and join the plaza (realtime).
As qa_support (or the admin token) POST /console/users/<qa_lv30>/status {status:'suspended', reason}.
With qa_lv30's existing access token call GET /me and GET /wallet.
From qa_lv30's open plaza connection send a room chat, then propose a 25-Star igisoro match to qa_pvp1 and let qa_pvp1 accept.
gaps.expected: The suspension takes effect at once: API requests with the old access token are refused (401/403), the realtime connection is closed (or the player is walked out), chat and proposals are refused, and no stake can be locked for a suspended account.
gaps.actual: /me and /wallet answer 200 for up to 15 minutes (access token lifetime); the realtime connection stays open indefinitely (it was authorised once at join); the chat is delivered; the match is created and 25 Stars are locked from qa_pvp1 into escrow against a suspended opponent. New sign-ins and token refreshes are correctly refused.
suspected: apps/api/src/common/auth.ts AuthGuard.canActivate — verifies the JWT only, never users.status
apps/realtime/src/auth.ts verifyToken + apps/realtime/src/rooms/world-room.ts onAuth — JWT only, checked once at join
apps/api/src/modules/games/games.service.ts create() — no users.status check before stake_lock
apps/api/src/modules/console/console.service.ts setStatus() — does not revoke refresh tokens or notify realtime

fix.retest: api.mjs /me,/wallet 401; pvp.mjs suspended player removed, can't chat or be staked; escrow voided + refunded

gaps.title: A suspended staff member keeps staff powers (console sections, staff endpoints) with their existing token
steps: Sign in as qa_it (it_admin).
As qa_super suspend qa_it with a reason.
With qa_it's existing access token call GET /console/users?q=qa_ (or any RoleGuard endpoint).
gaps.expected: 403/401: a suspended account has no staff rights, even before its access token expires.
gaps.actual: 200 — RoleGuard checks the roles in the DB on every request but not the account status, so a suspended it_admin can still list people, suspend others, close buildings for up to 15 minutes (and longer through an open office/console session).
suspected: apps/api/src/modules/admin-block/access.service.ts access() — returns roles regardless of users.status
apps/realtime/src/social/office-access.ts accessOf — same data for office doors / answering knocks

gaps.title: Suspended account is told 'That doesn't look right. Check it and try again.' at the gate
steps: At /gate enter qa.suspended@example.test, send code, enter the dev code, Verify.
gaps.expected: A clear message that the account is suspended and how to contact support (the API answers 401 ACCOUNT_INACTIVE).
gaps.actual: The generic validation message, as if the code were mistyped (desktop and phone).
gaps.evidence: ui-gate-desktop / ui-gate-phone: gate.suspended refused with a clear message (FAIL, 3 runs)

fix.retest: ui-gate: 'This account is suspended. Contact support.'

gaps.title: At a closed building (console) or the arena door when barred, the player is stopped silently: no 'closed' / 'not allowed' message, doors look open
steps: Close the Ludo Lounge from the console with the message 'QA closed: back at 18:00' (or sign in as qa_barred for the arena).
As qa_lv1 walk (click-to-walk) from the plaza to the Ludo door and into it.
gaps.expected: The player is kept out AND sees 'Ludo Lounge is closed · back at 18:00' (WorldHud) / the arena 'You can't enter the arena' card (ArenaDoorWatch).
gaps.actual: The player is kept out (correct) but stands at the glass doors with no message; the Interact button shows no closed label. Staff walk in correctly.
gaps.evidence: ui-closed-desktop (2 runs), ui-buildings-desktop arena.barred message (2 runs); screenshot reproducible with node qa/e2e/ui-closed.mjs ($TMPDIR/gk-qa/shots/closed-door-player-desktop.jpg)
suspected: apps/web/src/world/Player.tsx proximity block (~l.383-409): nearPortal depends on facing + INTERACT_RADIUS and the re-entry guard

fix.retest: ui-closed desktop 10/10, phone 10/10; arena barred: door shut + plain-words card

gaps.title: A player's responsible-play status is disclosed to the opponent (ON_A_BREAK / DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED)
steps: qa_break (on a 7-day break) challenges qa_pvp1 for 25 Stars; qa_pvp1 accepts.
Or both join quick match pool/25.
gaps.expected: The person on a break / over their limit learns why; the opponent only sees a neutral 'This match can't start'.
gaps.actual: Both players receive proposal-closed / quickmatch error with reason ON_A_BREAK or DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED, revealing a self-exclusion or limit to a stranger.
gaps.evidence: pvp.mjs limits.* (4 runs): opponent receives {status:'error', reason:'ON_A_BREAK'}
suspected: apps/realtime/src/rooms/world-room.ts proposal-respond catch (~l.473) and quickmatch-join catch (~l.492)

gaps.title: Console People search cannot find usernames containing '_' (e.g. 'qa_lv30')
steps: In the console People section (or GET /console/users?q=qa_lv30) search 'qa_lv30'.
gaps.actual: 'No accounts match.' — the search strips '_' and '%' instead of escaping them, so it looks for 'qalv30'. Searching 'lv30' works.
gaps.evidence: api.mjs console.search (2 runs), ui-console-desktop console.people search (2 runs)

gaps.title: A super admin can revoke their own super_admin role (the last one) — staff lock-out
steps: As qa_super (the only super admin) POST /admin/access/revoke {user:'qa_super', role:'super_admin'}.
gaps.expected: Refused (CANNOT_CHANGE_SELF / LAST_SUPER_ADMIN), like the suspend protections.
gaps.actual: 200 changed:true — no super admin is left; recovery needs the admin token or the CLI.
gaps.evidence: api.mjs roles.super-cannot-revoke-own-super (2 runs; the test re-grants the role with the admin token)

gaps.title: Plaza and halls exceed the Standard tier budgets (DESIGN-SPEC §16.1: ≤150 draw calls, ≤300k triangles)
steps: node qa/e2e/ui-world.mjs desktop / phone — perf.* lines (WebGL draw calls counted per frame + __gkProbe.calls/.tris).
gaps.expected: Standard tier: ≤ 150 draw calls and ≤ 300k visible triangles (phones may cap at 30–45 fps).
gaps.actual: Plaza 398 calls / 995k tris (desktop), 457 calls / 1.01M tris (phone viewport); Pool Hall 243 / 697k; Ludo 98 / 502k; Igisoro 141 / 403k; Arena 233 / 355k; Admin Block 92 / 110k (ok). 60 fps on the M-series GPU used, so the risk is real phones.
suspected: apps/web/src/world/SceneCanvas.tsx (tier selection) and the plaza / hall scene builders (world/*, rooms/*): instancing / merging, LOD for crowds and props

fix.retest: all halls ≤150 calls on desktop; plaza 159–258 calls / ~415k tris and hall triangles 318–353k still over — follow-up: texture atlas for district/doors, lighter chair models

steps: POST /console/users/not-a-uuid/status with the admin token and a valid body.

gaps.title: Daily limit / break are only checked after the opponent accepts
steps: qa_limit (limit 100) challenges qa_pvp1 for 200 Stars; qa_pvp1 sees the challenge and accepts.
gaps.expected: The challenge is refused when sent (the challenger can't offer a stake they may not play).

gaps.title: Room-scope chat from the lobby is delivered to people inside closed offices

gaps.expected: To confirm with product: offices are closed rooms (voice is scoped); text room chat probably should not reach inside either.
gaps.actual: The lobby room chat reaches the staff member inside; office-chat correctly stays inside.
gaps.evidence: office.mjs office.lobby room chat heard inside the office = true (2 runs)
suspected: apps/realtime/src/rooms/world-room.ts chat handler (l.310) — no OfficeDesk.sameRoom filter for scope 'room'

gaps.title: Visitors stay inside an office after the last staff member leaves
steps: Let three visitors into Customer Support, then the staff member steps out.
gaps.expected: To confirm with product: visitors are asked to leave (or the office shows them as waiting) when no staff is inside.
gaps.actual: occupancy shows occupants 0, visitors 3; the visitors remain inside an unstaffed office.
gaps.evidence: office.mjs office.after staff left note (2 runs)

gaps.title: Plaza movement is client-authoritative (no speed / teleport check)
steps: From a realtime client send 'move' with any x/z inside ±60 m.
gaps.expected: Positions bounded by walking speed (proximity features — chat range, pair actions, office doors — rely on positions).
gaps.actual: Any position is accepted and broadcast; a bot was placed next to a player instantly.

fix.retest: realtime movement tests (9 m/s, 8 m jump)

gaps.expected: Names (e.g. 'qa_it closed a building · Ludo Lounge').

gaps.title: Esc did not open the menu in Igisoro practice after moves (arrow key focused the top-bar Menu button)

known_not_new: Arena commentator mic uses P2P voice (max ~8 peers; LiveKit not wired)
Arena VIP voice scope is client-side only
Players can't sit at arena stage tables yet
Arena boards show no live match data
No scarf / flag wave; seat pads always down; Stand & cheer releases the seat
test_tool_issues: OTP limit (3 / 10 min) + rotating refresh cookies: running two QA scripts at once makes their session caches overwrite each other (stale cookie → the browser lands on the gate). Run scripts one at a time.
Igisoro practice: Esc did not open the menu in the scripted sequence after moves (2 runs) but did in isolation — unconfirmed, not reported.
Arena v2 seat finder: the scripted 'Find a seat → best free seat' did not reach a seat within 45 s after the v2 merge — script needs updating to the v2 flow; not reported as a product gap.
Admin block: officer computer prompt and lobby chairs need walking to exact spots; not automated (console reached via /console instead).
Contrast check counts gradient-backed buttons as low contrast (computed background is transparent).

retest.note: FIX-A and FIX-B merged; pnpm verify 67/67; coordinator smoke test on dev servers (gate, plaza, Pool Hall) no page errors
